sql_calls.sql:
SELECT sku, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'empty') AS empty_n, MIN(audit_ts::date) AS first_d, MAX(audit_ts::date) AS last_d
FROM store.shelf_audits
GROUP BY sku
ORDER BY sku;

SELECT SUM(forecast_units_per_day) AS forecast_total,
       (SELECT SUM(units_sold) FROM store.daily_sales WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date>='2026-06-01' AND date<'2026-07-01') AS actual_total,
       SUM(forecast_units_per_day) - (SELECT SUM(units_sold) FROM store.daily_sales WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date>='2026-06-01' AND date<'2026-07-01') AS gap
FROM store.forecasts
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= '2026-06-01' AND date < '2026-07-01';

SELECT date, units_sold
FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND units_sold = 0
ORDER BY date;

SELECT g.received_ts::date AS d, g.asn_sku, g.asn_units, g.sku_booked, g.units_booked
FROM store.goods_receipts g
WHERE g.asn_sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND g.received_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND g.received_ts < '2026-07-01'
ORDER BY g.received_ts;

SELECT s.audit_ts::date AS audit_date, s.status, d.units_sold
FROM store.shelf_audits s
JOIN store.daily_sales d ON d.sku = s.sku AND d.date = s.audit_ts::date
WHERE s.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY s.audit_ts;

SELECT created_ts::date AS d, units, cases
FROM store.store_orders
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND created_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND created_ts < '2026-07-01'
ORDER BY created_ts;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.bill_id) AS bills_no_approval
FROM payments.pos_payments p
WHERE p.bill_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT bill_id FROM store.pos_lines WHERE bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01')
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments.pos_payments p2 WHERE p2.bill_id = p.bill_id AND p2.till_status = 'approved');

SELECT p.tender, p.till_status, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM payments.pos_payments p
WHERE p.bill_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT bill_id FROM store.pos_lines WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND bill_ts>='2026-06-01' AND bill_ts<'2026-07-01')
GROUP BY p.tender, p.till_status
ORDER BY p.tender, p.till_status;
